About this item

  • ENCAP midsole cushioning combines soft foam with a durable polyurethane rim in these mens 574 sneakers for all-day support and comfort.
  • The suede and mesh upper on these new balance 574 men delivers the iconic look that has made the 574 a wardrobe staple for decades.
  • Vamp, collar, and tongue mesh are made from 100% recycled polyester, making these classic sneakers men a more responsible choice without sacrificing style.
  • A rubber outsole with 5% recycled rubber gives these lifestyle sneakers men lasting grip and durability for everyday wear.
  • Available in extended width sizes, these retro sneakers men provide a comfortable fit for a wide range of foot shapes.

Product Description

The 574 is New Balance's quintessential shoe, embodying reliability and versatility. It wasn't designed for cutting-edge tech or luxury materials, but rather to excel in various tasks. Its unassuming, adaptable nature made it a global closet staple, blending road and trail design with a wider last than its predecessors. Today, the 574 is synonymous with New Balance's boundary-pushing style, worn by all.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sneakers comfortable, with one noting their feet remain pain-free during long walks, and appreciate their appearance, with one mentioning they can be dressed up or down.     5 out of 5 stars
    Title: Classic style and comfortable enough for all-day wear
    Reviewed in the United States on June 17, 2026
    Color: Grey/WhiteSize: 11 Wide
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    These match everything!

    I’ve owned several pairs of New Balance over the years, and the 574 Core continues to be one of my favorites. I bought these primarily for everyday wear, and they’ve been comfortable right out of the box.

    The combination of support and cushioning makes them easy to wear for long periods, whether I’m running errands, traveling, or spending most of the day on my feet. I also like the classic design since they pair well with jeans, shorts, and casual clothes without looking overly sporty.

    The materials feel well made, and so far they’ve held up nicely with regular use. One thing to be aware of is that the fit may feel a little snug at first, especially if you have wider feet, so sizing is worth paying attention to.

    Overall, these are dependable, comfortable shoes that have earned their reputation. If you’re looking for a versatile everyday sneaker with timeless styling, the 574 Core is hard to go wrong with.

About this Item

  • ENCAP midsole cushioning combines soft foam with a durable polyurethane rim in these mens 574 sneakers for all-day support and comfort.
  • The suede and mesh upper on these new balance 574 men delivers the iconic look that has made the 574 a wardrobe staple for decades.
  • Vamp, collar, and tongue mesh are made from 100% recycled polyester, making these classic sneakers men a more responsible choice without sacrificing style.
  • A rubber outsole with 5% recycled rubber gives these lifestyle sneakers men lasting grip and durability for everyday wear.
  • Available in extended width sizes, these retro sneakers men provide a comfortable fit for a wide range of foot shapes.

Product Description

The New Balance 574 V3 is one of the most recognized mens 574 sneakers in the world, and for good reason. Originally built as a hybrid road and trail running shoe, the 574 earned its place as a closet staple through reliable comfort and effortless versatility. These new balance 574 men feature ENCAP midsole cushioning that pairs soft foam with a durable polyurethane rim for support that lasts all day. The suede and mesh upper is built with sustainability in mind, using 100% recycled polyester in the vamp, collar, and tongue mesh. These classic sneakers men work with just about anything in your wardrobe and come in extended width sizes for a fit that suits more people. Simple, comfortable, and built to last, these lifestyle sneakers men are the everyday shoe you will reach for again and again.
